svg.title: 5B cells in 25.7 minutes
svg.desc: Technical report evaluation: Scaling to one billion cells. Replicated CELLxGENE corpus with independently permuted gene mappings, exactly 1B cells (1.85 TB), five fresh global permutations, two NVMe SSDs in RAID-0, 8 planner cores + 48 loader cores, 1 TB compressed-page cache retained across epochs, 1B-access planning horizon. Fixed 2048-gene float32 output; every delivered cell decoded (zero decoded-row hits). Loader-start epoch timings include startup, exclude metadata opening. Steady throughput is 4B / total duration of epochs 2-5. Measured time-series rates are shown as non-overlapping five-second bins, weighted by cumulative cell deltas and elapsed time; no smoothing across epochs.

text.font-family: 'CP Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
'CP Head', 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif

g.text: Five epochs over a 1B-cell corpus, freshly shuffled every epoch
